newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak President accepts Transport Min resignation.
newsitem.headline: Slovak President accepts Transport Min resignation.

text.p: Slovak President Michal Kovac on Monday accepted the resignation of Tranport, Post and Telecommunication Minister Alexander Rezes for health reasons, the local news agency TASR reported.
"The president today accepted resignation of Alexander Rezes, effective April 15," TASR quoted presidential spokesman Vladimir Stefko as saying.
At the beginning of March Rezes tendered his resignation due to unspecified health reasons.
Stefko said Kovac would "soon" name Jan Jasovsky to the post. Jasovsky is currently director of Slovenska Posta s.p., the state-run postal monopoly.
TASR did not give further details. Neither the president's office nor government officials were immediately available for comment.
